title: Tonopah S4 workers flown in by Janet

tellings.quote: employees on the S4 area of Tonipa test range have to be taken there directly from Janet and cannot drive on site like other employees at Tonipa can.

plain: Workers at S4, an area of the Tonopah Test Range in Nevada long rumoured to house secret craft work, are said to be flown straight in on Janet, the unmarked airline that carries staff to secret Nevada sites, and are not allowed to drive in as other Tonopah employees can. The online researcher known as UAPGerb tells it, crediting the claim to a source he names as Lazy G Ranch, and offers it as a sign that S4 is guarded even more tightly than the rest of the range.
